notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).  DEDI 2026-09-22 (run map05, after the mount fix): the map now LOADS and spawns a server (`------ Server Initialization ------ / Server: nazi_zombie_test1`), then dies with a GSC runtime error and the server shuts down. `undefined is not an array, string, or vector` at `common_scripts/utility.gsc:463 while( !level.flag[ msg ] )`, from `maps/zombie_hitmarker.gsc:38 flag_wait("all_players_connected")`, threaded at `nazi_zombie_test1.gsc:136`. `level.flag` is created by `maps/_load.gsc:97`'s `flag_init("all_players_connected")`, so a map-provided script is flag_waiting before `_load::main()` has run. NOT ours: we mount no overlay (fs_game is the map's own mod, the referee is C++ and ships nothing inside it), the console shows `Loading fastfile 'mod'` and the map fastfile loading, and Der Berg answers getstatus with the same mount. Why the same script survives on a listen server is NOT established. dedi.md 13.3, referee.md 10. RETRACTION: the earlier note blamed `fs_game is write protected` and a `config.cfg` in the homepath. Both are wrong -- every map prints that line including the ones that boot, and there is no config.cfg anywhere under ZombiesDev\homes. The real cause of `Can't find map` was that the map was not mounted under fs_localAppData (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Activision\CoDWaW\mods), which is what the engine's map-exists check opens with CreateFileA. tools\dev\mapmount.ps1 fixes that and the map is past it now.
